fields.title: Xylem Inc. General SEC Filings
capital_markets_activity: Recent filings include debt issuance and financing-related 8-K disclosure.
capital_allocation_activity: This information can assist investors in assessing our financial performance and measures our ability to generate capital for deployment among competing strategic alternatives and initiatives, including, but not limited to, dividends, acquisitions, share repurchases and debt repayment.

Repurchases include both share repurchase programs approved by the Board of Directors and repurchases in relation to settlement of employee tax withholding obligations due as a result of the vesting of restricted stock units.
liquidity_notes: We monitor our global funding requirements and seek to meet our liquidity needs on a cost-effective basis.
governance_notes: Recent 8-K filings include governance and board composition updates.
controls_and_risk_notes: CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures Our management, with the Chief Executive Officer ("CEO") and Chief Financial Officer ("CFO") of the Company, has evaluated the effectiveness of the design and operation of our disclosure controls and procedures as of the end of the year ended December 31, 2025 pursuant to Rule 13a-15(b) and 15d-15(e) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (“the Exchange Act”).
